correctness.rationale: The scale-two neighborhood generators are exact; a non-flag face contains two disjoint original edges, and absence of 3- or 4-cycles forces a unique connecting generator. Generator toggling pairs all non-flag faces, and descending-size processing makes every pair a free-face elementary collapse. The star-simplex cover of the remaining flag complex has nerve H. The first-homology inclusion kernel is the sum of local clique cycle lattices with disjoint edge supports, so the sum is direct and has stated rank. Sample finite full-face checker successfully replays every collapse.

value.rationale: Applies to all finite connected girth-at-least-five original graphs, including arbitrary degrees, bridges and nontrivial cycle rank, and recovers topology from a line graph whose own girth may be three. An explicit simplicial collapse is stronger than a Betti computation; the integral local triangle kernel describes the first persistent loss of homology. Triangles and quadrilaterals supply motivated sharp boundaries.
